$comment: Cross-references in apidoc source that name something which does not exist.
Each is a bug in the source repo, not in docgen. They are listed here so the
compile fails on NEW breakage while these stay visible; delete an entry as soon
as the upstream fix lands, and docgen will tell you when one is no longer hit.
Keyed by source repo: an entry only applies to, and is only reported stale by,
a compile of that repo. Without that, compiling any module would report all 23
SDK entries as no-longer-occurring, which reads as 'upstream fixed everything'.
A module's entries cover references into the SDK too: those are checked against
the compiled SDK index it is told to resolve against, so a module naming a type
or member the SDK does not have fails the same way one of its own does.
Run docgen with --strict to compile as if this file were empty.

tidev/titanium-sdk.Global.Intl.NumberFormat.NumberFormatOpt: declared as the top-level pseudo-type NumberFormatOptions, not nested under NumberFormat
tidev/titanium-sdk.Ti.Color: no such type; colors are plain Strings
tidev/titanium-sdk.Titanium.App.Android.R.color: R is a dynamic resource namespace with no documented members
tidev/titanium-sdk.Titanium.Geolocation.frequency: removed property, still referenced from Geolocation.Android
tidev/titanium-sdk.Titanium.Media.allowMultiple: belongs to the options dictionaries, not the Media module
tidev/titanium-sdk.Titanium.UI.TabGroup.disableTabOptions: the pseudo-type is disableTabOptions, not a TabGroup member
tidev/titanium-sdk.Titanium.UI.iOS.createAlertDialog: AlertDialog lives in Titanium.UI, so the factory is Titanium.UI.createAlertDialog

$comment: References broken only in published releases, which are immutable and
therefore cannot be fixed upstream. Allowed like `refs`, but never
reported stale: an entry here describes a frozen past and will stop
occurring the moment the affected releases age out of what we compile,
which is not the same as upstream having fixed anything.

tidev/titanium-sdk.Titanium.UI.iOS.AttributedString: the type is Titanium.UI.AttributedString; Label, TextArea and TextField kept the pre-move iOS. name until it was corrected between 12.8.0 and 13.2.0. Blocks every GA from 12.5.0 to 13.1.1.
